rows.ARS:
Light yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORikon
Exhibition name: Limelight
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1984).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1984 as 'Limelight'.
rows.Bloom: Light yellow. Strong fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, double (17-25 petals), exhibition, high-centered, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower, exhibition or garden. Shade tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Peach Melba (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1978) ×
Unnamed Seedling
rows.Notes: Zimbabwe patent application No. 8810 on April 25, 1988
